messages:
maya: FYI - customer (Acme) opened a ticket: their SSO started failing right after an IdP cert rotation. Getting 403 on our ACS endpoint. They say last successful login was ~1716032000.

jake: Can you paste the exact error from our logs? 403 could be a recipient mismatch or signature verify fail.

maya: From edge logs: 
```
2024-05-17T14:22:11Z WARN saml: assertion validation failed: RecipientMismatch: got https://app.acme.com/saml/acs, expected https://redwood.app/saml/acs
2024-05-17T14:22:11Z INFO id: tenant=acme-123 request_id=xyz
```

maya: Customer metadata includes two AssertionConsumerService entries. They switched to a new ACS host during rollout: `https://app.acme.com/saml/acs` (primary) and older `https://app.acme.internal/acs` (legacy). We currently expect the exact registered ACS in our tenant config `https://redwood.app/saml/acs`.

sam: Hmm - that log looks like our ACS normalization isn't matching the IdP's Recipient. Could be our recent metadata poller change where we started stripping trailing slashes and normalizing host aliases. @jake did we change any normalize rules in last week's patch?

jake: I pushed a small tweak to the metadata watcher to canonicalize hostnames for known cloud aliases (removes `www.` and port 443). Not supposed to rewrite customer ACS. Let me check the deploy.

idp-watchdog-bot: [metadata-poller] fetched idp metadata for tenant acme-123 at 2024-05-17T14:19:08Z, sha256=ab12...ef. KeyDescriptors: signing(1), encryption(1). poll_delay=60s TTL=300s

maya: Customer says they rotated signing certs. Their metadata now has signing key with keyId `key-2024-05-17`. Old key still present but order changed. They observed failures 2m after rotation.

sam: Order change + our key selection bug could cause us to pick the wrong KeyDescriptor for signature validation if we assume first==signing. Check the codepath in saml/verify: does it iterate with tag name only or check use="signing"?

jake: Quick repro steps I want us to run against staging:
1) curl -fsSL https://idp.acme.com/metadata -o acme-metadata.xml
2) start a local idp server returning metadata with KeyDescriptor order reversed (swap nodes)
3) hit our staging ACS with SAMLResponse that includes `Recipient`=https://app.acme.com/saml/acs and signed by new key. Expect: either success or RecipientMismatch if our ACS policy uses tenant config (`https://redwood.app/saml/acs`).

maya: Also note the customer is behind a proxy that rewrites host header to `redwood.app` for some flows (they claim). Could be we see a different Host at edge vs the Recipient in assertion -> mismatch. They provided this excerpt from their proxy config: `proxy_set_header Host $upstream_host;` which sometimes keeps internal host.

sam: Two parallel tracks: 1) Verify metadata key selection doesn't assume order (priority bug) and 2) check ACS host header normalization logic in the edge -> app handoff. If customer's proxy rewrites Host we may be comparing the wrong value.

jake: I can reproduce a Host header mismatch locally by curling with `-H "Host: redwood.app"` while Recipient is `https://app.acme.com/saml/acs`. That gives RecipientMismatch in our verify code.

maya: Customer asked for a quick workaround: can we add the `https://app.acme.com/saml/acs` as an allowed ACS alternate for tenant acme-123? They want minimal change.

sam: Yes, adding alternate ACS to tenant config is safest short-term. I'll open an internal config change: add `app.acme.com` as allowed recipient for acme-123 and deploy a small ACL. But we should not rely on that long-term.

jake: I'll prepare a unit test and a patch: ensure SAML keyselection uses `KeyDescriptor[@use='signing']` and falls back to matching KeyInfo by cert fingerprint. Also add a normalization check so we compare the assertion Recipient against all registered ACS URLs (canonicalized) rather than host header.

maya: I'll respond to customer: ask them to keep old key in metadata for at least 10 minutes after rotation, and request they avoid proxy host rewrite until we confirm. Sending them a repro doc and ETA for workaround. :white_check_mark:

sam: Plan: (a) emergency config change to add alternate ACS (maya) (b) patch + test in staging (jake) (c) postmortem and guidance in support KB about cert rotation ordering and ACS canonicalization (sam).

maya: Created ticket SUP-2248, linked customer case, applied temporary ACS alternate. Will ping when we confirm login success.

jake: I'll start the fix PR now and link it to SUP-2248.

maya: Thanks team. Keeping thread open for updates. :pray:
